alternatives_rejected.why: emailservice's own span self-time is flat at 0.19ms (1.01x), so its processing did not slow. Only caller-observed latency rose, from 3.66 to 203.82ms (E2). No emailservice CPU metric appears among the top deviations either (E1).
checkoutservice latency rose much less (p90 +104.7%) than emailservice's (p90 +4511.2%) (E1). Its slowdown fits waiting on the delayed emailservice call, which inbound traces show slowing 55x (E2).

proposed_fix.description: First check for an injected network delay on emailservice, such as a tc netem qdisc or fault-injection rule on the pod's interface, and remove it. If none is found, roll out a restart of the emailservice pod. Then confirm emailservice and checkoutservice p50/p90 latency return to baseline.
